$comment: BL-4501 shell steam boiler twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the maker's data, the steam table and the combustion formulas; the boiler sends only what it measures.

identification.model: UNIVERSAL UL-S 10,000 x 16 (three-pass shell boiler with integrated economiser)
identification.description: Process steam boiler, gas-fired, 10 t/h saturated steam at 13 bar g, plant utilities boiler house
identification.type: Three-pass shell boiler: flame tube (1st pass), wetback reversing chamber, smoke tubes (2nd and 3rd pass)
identification.burner: Modulating natural gas burner with O2 trim (burner make is project specific)
identification.economiser: Integrated flue gas heat exchanger ECO, feedwater side
identification.controls: Boiler control BCO: continuous level control, automatic conductivity measurement and desalting, low-level limiters, pressure limiter

boiler.source: Bosch UL-S 10,000 x 16 case study on boiler-planning.com (system steam output 10,000 kg/h, p avg = 13 bar, safety pressure 16 bar in the size code); UL-S range 1,250 to 28,000 kg/h, up to 30 bar, from the Bosch UL-S product page

feedwater.source: Feedwater from a thermal deaerator, not colder than 103 C (boiler-planning.com). Feedwater conductivity 240 uS/cm: assumption: typical value, replace with your softened make-up and condensate return mix. Residual hardness alert 0.02 mmol/l: assumption: typical value, replace with the limit of EN 12953-10 for your boiler and your water treatment contract

boiler_water.source: Conductivity setpoint 5,000 uS/cm (= 3,500 ppm TDS at 0.7 ppm per uS/cm, the level Spirax Sarco gives for larger shell boilers) and alert 6,000 uS/cm: assumption: typical value, replace with the boiler maker's water specification and EN 12953-10

combustion.source: Siegert flue gas loss qA = f (t_fg - t_air) / CO2 with CO2 = CO2max (1 - O2/21); natural gas H: CO2max 11.94 %, f 0.4731 at 0 % O2 and 0.4469 at 5 % O2, linear in between; air reference 25 C per EN 12953-11 (all boiler-planning.com, Combustion efficiency). Excess air = 87 x O2/(21 - O2): fit to the air-ratio table on the same page (lambda 1.15 at 3.09 % O2). LHV 36.0 MJ/Nm3: assumption: typical value, replace with your gas supplier's net calorific value. Design O2 3.0 % and radiation loss 0.4 % at full load: assumption: typical value, replace with the commissioning report of your burner and boiler. CO alert 100 ppm: assumption: typical value, replace with your burner setting report

heat_transfer.source: Flue gas at the boiler outlet about 60 K above the steam temperature and economiser outlet 120 to 140 C (boiler-planning.com); the lower end, 120 C, reproduces the 95.4 % of the UL-S 10,000 x 16 case study with the Siegert formula. Approach falling with load^0.5, flue gas pressure drop 12 mbar at full load rising with load^1.8: assumption: typical value, replace with your boiler's acceptance test data

feed_pump.source: Multistage feed pump curve p = p0 - k (feed t/h)^2: 19.5 bar g at shut-off, 17.5 bar g at 10.5 t/h. Margin alert 2 bar over the steam pressure (control valve, economiser and non-return valve), level deviation alert 50 mm from the normal water level: assumption: typical value, replace with your pump data sheet and boiler control settings

tests.source: Functional test of the low-water limiters daily and a manual lift of the safety valves weekly: assumption: typical value, replace with the intervals of your national rules (for example for operation without constant supervision) and the maker's operating manual

economics.source: CO2 56.1 t/TJ for natural gas (IPCC 2006 default, net calorific value basis). Gas price 36 USD/MWh (10 USD/GJ) and 6,000 h a year: assumption: typical value, replace with your own contract and running hours

steam_table.fit: x = ln(p_abs in bar): y = c0 + c1 x + c2 x^2 for Tsat (C), h' and h'' (kJ/kg), 6 to 20 bar abs; liquid h(T) = a T + b T^2 + c T^3 for 100 to 212 C
steam_table.source: Least-squares fits to the saturated steam table (engineeringtoolbox.com, IAPWS values); worst error 0.03 K and 0.2 kJ/kg in the range

demo.note: Demo only: the steam demand swings between 60 and 100 % over 15 minutes so the load-corrected expectations are seen working; test counters advance with the plant clock.

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

fireside_fouling.name: Fire-side fouling (soot in the smoke tubes)
fireside_fouling.symptoms: boiler exit temperature up at the same load, flue gas pressure drop up; the economiser hides most of the efficiency loss

waterside_scale.name: Water-side scale (hardness breakthrough)
waterside_scale.symptoms: feedwater hardness up, boiler exit temperature up at the same load, flue gas pressure drop normal

economiser_fouling.name: Economiser fouling
economiser_fouling.symptoms: economiser effectiveness down, stack temperature up, efficiency down

excess_air_high.name: Excess air too high (O2 trim drift, air leak)
excess_air_high.symptoms: O2 up, flue gas loss up at the same stack temperature

tds_control_fault.name: TDS control fault (blowdown valve stuck, probe fouled)
tds_control_fault.symptoms: boiler water conductivity above its setpoint and rising: foaming and carry-over risk

blowdown_valve_passing.name: Blowdown valve passing
blowdown_valve_passing.symptoms: feed flow well above steam flow, boiler water far below its setpoint: hot water and chemicals to drain

feed_pump_wear.name: Feed pump wear
feed_pump_wear.symptoms: discharge pressure below the pump curve, margin over the boiler pressure gone, level sags

safety_tests_overdue.name: Low-water limiter and safety valve tests skipped
safety_tests_overdue.symptoms: hours since the last limiter test and the last safety valve lift grow past their intervals
